unreachable: The mail server's management API is unreachable. Check that the server is running and the panel is configured.
unavailable: The server did not answer for this card. Retry from the notice at the top of the page.

deliveries.heading: Deliveries
deliveries.disabled: The server keeps no delivery records, so there is nothing to chart. Set a retention above 0 days for the log in the server's storage settings.
deliveries.empty: Nothing was sent, deferred or refused. A longer period may have records.
deliveries.full: The server returned {limit} records, the most it gives, so this period may hold more. These figures are of those {limit} only; the delivery log can narrow them by outcome, period and recipient.

outcomes.title: Deliveries by outcome
outcomes.description: {total, plural, one {# delivery record} other {# delivery records}}: {parts}.

timeline.title: Deliveries over time
timeline.description: {total, plural, one {# delivery record} other {# delivery records}} {unit, select, hour {per hour} other {per day}}. The most, {peak}, on {when}.
timeline.hintPartial: {when}: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} ({parts}), possibly in part
timeline.hintMissing: {when}: may not have been returned by the server
timeline.full: The server returned {limit} records, the most it gives, so the shaded columns may not have been returned, or only in part. They are not known to be times without deliveries.

queue.title: Queue by waiting time
queue.recipients: {count, plural, one {# recipient pending} other {# recipients pending}}
queue.recipientsRead: {count, plural, one {# recipient pending} other {# recipients pending}} in the messages read
queue.description: {count, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}} in the queue: {parts}.
queue.descriptionRead: {count, plural, one {The oldest message} other {The # oldest messages}} of a queue that holds more: {parts}.
queue.capped: These are the {count} oldest messages. The queue holds more, all of them newer.
queue.empty: No message is waiting to be sent.

suppression.title: Suppressed addresses by domain
suppression.description: {count, plural, one {# suppressed address} other {# suppressed addresses}} by domain: {parts}.
suppression.descriptionRead: {count, plural, one {The first suppressed address} other {The first # suppressed addresses}} in alphabetical order, of a list that holds more, by domain: {parts}.
suppression.capped: These are the first {count} addresses in alphabetical order. The list holds more, so this ranking of domains is of these {count} only.
suppression.empty: The server refuses no recipient. A hard bounce adds one here.
